facilities-town.notes: Top tree groves (y~0-60): new crowns sit lower than old ones; leftover old-outline pixels float above the crowns at (255,13) and (735,13). Crowns are recoloured olive with yellow highlights, so they read autumnal in a summer-green town; this is not blocking on its own. Buildings and ground are unchanged.

river-town.notes: Top tree row (y~10-60, x~280-1030): each crown's left edge is a straight vertical cut with a detached jagged dark/lime outline beside it. A stray dark 2px speck sits at the upper right of each crown (y=27; x=299,347,491,539,635,827,875,923,1019). The trunk has shrunk to a stub. Lower groves (y~320-440) look fine.

village50.notes: Same orphan pixels as facilities-town at (255,13), (735,13) and (192,413), so this is the same top-grove artifact.

tool-village.notes: Large twin-oak cluster (~x205-300, y110-210): a visible vertical seam line runs down the canopy centre at x~241, y~165-192, and the crown is built from hard horizontal bands. The new conifers and bushes elsewhere read fine. About 118 small unchanged dark specks sit near changed areas; many are probably ground speckle, but some are crown leftovers (e.g. 752,17).

blocking_regressions.where: top tree row y~10-60, x~280-1030 (zoom: lookcheck/zr3.png)
blocking_regressions.what: Crown left edge is cut flat with a detached outline, and a stray dark speck sits above each crown (y=27). Old-outline remnants or a cell boundary are cutting through the crown.
Floating dark 2-3px pixels above the top grove crowns. These are unchanged old-crown outline pixels left behind after the redraw.
Vertical tile seam line visible inside the merged canopy.

minor: Summer town trees are now olive/yellow-tipped (facilities-town, village50) and read autumnal next to the bright grass.
Trunks shortened to stubs on the river-town top row.
Canopy shading uses flat horizontal bands (tool-village oak cluster) and looks less organic than before.
